name: Miyagi

flag.description: A white emblem on a dark green field: the hiragana み (mi) drawn as three bush-clover leaves.
flag.symbolism: Miyagino bush clover (Miyaginohagi) is the prefectural flower and み the first sound of Miyagi; the middle leaf stands for lasting growth, the left for harmony and the right for love of home.

hook: Miyagi's white み (mi) curls into three bush-clover leaves on dark green; Mie's み is a straight arrow on bright green.
trivia: Sendai, the capital, is the largest city in the Tōhoku region.
Matsushima Bay, with over 200 pine-covered islets, is counted among the Three Views of Japan.
